run_train_instance_segmentation: run the instance segmentation training script with configurable epochs, batch size, and CUDA support
run_train_epoch: run a single training epoch on the instance segmentation model with BCE loss and masked gradient sampling
run_validate: run validation on the instance segmentation model using validation data
run_print_slices: run debug slice printing to compare model input, ground truth, and predicted outputs for a data sample
run_blocks_from_data: run extraction of non-zero block coordinates and values from a voxel data sample
